copy.curiosityHook: In a changing country fresh from warfare, can a renowned swordsman truly defend the vulnerable using an inverted blade that forbids him to kill?
copy.description: In 1868, following the close of the Bakumatsu war, former assassin Kenshin Himura roams Japan armed with a reversed-edge sword, committed to protecting people in need without taking another life.
copy.vibeSummary: Exciting and reflective samurai action, carrying swift martial energy and measured dramatic weight.
copy.whyWatch: Director Keishi Otomo pairs dynamic period martial arts with the moral friction of an elite killer trying to navigate a new era through strict nonviolence.

allowedMaterial: Kenshin Himura's past as an assassin
Kenshin's journey across Japan with an inverted sword
His code of defending the needy without killing
excludedMaterial: Specific adversaries, villains, or culprit reveals
